title: Implementation Pack — milestone task state
description: The persistent state of a Milestone (Annex H §5.2). This file is what the autonomous loop reads to know where it is; the conversation is not, and neither is memory. Every field here exists because losing it costs a session.

status.description: The Milestone's own state. The same vocabulary as a Story's, so there is one set of words to learn.

dependencies.description: Milestones that must be done first.

file.description: Path to the Story, relative to the milestone directory. Validated to exist: a Story the loop cannot open is a Story it cannot implement.

dependsOn.description: Stories in the same Milestone that must be done first. Validated for existence and for cycles.

attempts.description: How many times this Story has been attempted. Three without progress means change strategy once; still no progress means `blocked` with a reproducible diagnosis — never an infinite loop (Annex H §16).

required.description: Whether the Milestone can close without it.

commit.description: The commit that closed the Story. Mandatory once status is done: a Story marked done with no commit is a claim with no checkpoint behind it.

blockedReason.description: Mandatory once status is blocked. The qualifier says who can unblock it, and the diagnosis has to be reproducible — 'it did not work' tells the next session nothing.

reproduce.description: The command that shows the block, so the next session does not have to rediscover it.

run.description: Per-run bookkeeping written by tools/opanel-loop: the turn counter the Stop hook increments and the baseline OPANEL_MAX_STORIES_PER_RUN counts against. Absent until a run starts; it describes the run, not the Milestone.
